acceptanceCriteria: Each generated .corvint directory has a documented retention bound (count or age) enforced by the writer or a cleanup command.
Evidence still referenced by a live CEM/receipt is never pruned.
body: In the primary checkout .corvint/history-backups is 16 MB and .corvint/test-evidence 23 MB on 2026-10-19 with no pruning; .corvint/changes is 14 MB. Small now, but unbounded and per-checkout.
title: .corvint/history-backups and .corvint/test-evidence grow without a retention bound
